description: API added to allow clients to use GCToolKit on the classpath

comments.body: I think you can remove this.

Future change would be to remove the @Tag("modulePath") and make the modulePath execution groups be <groups>!classPath</groups>. This would be preferred since others adding tests may not be aware of the tag or why the tag is needed.
This @Tag could/should be at the class level.
Yikes. This is a breaking change on top of the breaking change from version 2.x.y (where the arg was a Class<? extends Aggregation>).
Should we externalize this in a properties file?
SRP?  Maybe this belongs in its own method
Not a breaking change, just an addition.
